# Astonish Property Group

> London-based property developer delivering luxury residential new builds, high-end refurbishment and premium kitchen sourcing across London and Hertfordshire, backed by 35 years of refurbishing flats and houses.

Website: https://www.astonishproperty.com/
Contact: sat@astonishproperty.com
Based in: London, UK
Areas served: London and Hertfordshire

## Services
- Build: ground-up residential development, with specialist contractors for each trade.
- Renovate: refurbishment and extensions to the highest standards using quality branded goods and materials.
- Kitchen sourcing: Pedini, Binova, Miton and Leicht kitchens.

## Projects
- The Walled Garden, Preston, Hertfordshire: featured ground-up luxury family home within the grounds of a historic walled estate.
- Altmore Avenue, East Ham, London E6: Victorian terrace extended from 3 bed / 1 bath to 5 bed / 3 bath with kitchen and loft extensions and a landscaped garden. Sold.
- Highgate, London N6: complete refurbishment of a 3-bedroom maisonette, held for long-term rental.
- Brondesbury Park, London NW6: full refurbishment of a 1,327 sq ft four-bedroom top-floor flat in an Art Deco mansion block on Willesden Lane.
